# Requirement Completeness Checklist: Dynamic Survey Viewer

**Purpose**: Validate that the requirements in `spec.md` and `contracts/` are complete — that every field
the contracts admit has observable behaviour, every respondent-visible string has a stated derivation, and
every principle the constitution binds us to has a requirement and a measurement.
**Created**: 2026-10-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [contracts/survey-json.md](../contracts/survey-json.md) · [contracts/response-submission.md](../contracts/response-submission.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Author's review pass**: the Product Owner ran every item below against the spec on 2026-10-08. Items
CHK006, CHK009, CHK010 and CHK014 failed and are fixed in the current revision of `spec.md` — see
[Checklist review](../spec.md#checklist-review--session-2026-10-08). Boxes are left unticked for the
reviewer regardless.

## Requirement Completeness — contract surface

- [ ] CHK001 Does every question type admitted by the contract have a rendering requirement and a required-ness rule? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-006..FR-010]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for every type-specific field the contract admits (`options`, `minSelections`, `maxSelections`, `minLength`, `maxLength`, `scale`, `attachments`)? [Coverage, Contract §2]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the behaviour of each contract default stated where the field is absent (`required`, `minSelections`, `maxSelections`, `minLength`, `maxLength`, `scale`)? [Completeness, Contract §2]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for an `attachments` block on each of the six types, given the contract allows one on any type? [Coverage, Contract §2]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the handling of `maxFiles: 0` versus an absent `attachments` block specified as identical? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK006 Do the optional `description` fields on a survey and on a page have rendering requirements, or does the contract admit fields with no observable behaviour? [Gap, Contract §2] — **failed; fixed by FR-073**
- [ ] CHK007 Is the rendering position of a question's `description` specified relative to its title and its error text? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the required-ness indicator required to be visible text rather than a symbol alone? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Completeness — respondent-visible strings

- [ ] CHK009 Is there a stated rule turning a byte count into the string a respondent reads, given scenarios assert "5 MB" for 5242880? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-025] — **failed; fixed by FR-071**
- [ ] CHK010 Is there a stated rule turning `acceptedTypes` into the labels a respondent reads, given the contract admits both MIME types and extensions? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-028] — **failed; fixed by FR-072**
- [ ] CHK011 Is the attachment counter's exact form specified, including its singular case? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the text of each submission-failure kind specified so a test can assert it? [Completeness, Contract §4]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the page indicator's exact form specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-032]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Does a measurable success criterion exist for Principle I's claim that a survey costs one config plus one manifest entry, or is FR-004 asserted but never measured? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004] — **failed; fixed by SC-013**
- [ ] CHK015 Is every success criterion stated as something a test or a gate can decide, with no criterion resting on reviewer judgement? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001..SC-014]
- [ ] CHK016 Does every acceptance scenario name a concrete input and a concrete expected output, rather than a quality? [Measurability, Spec §User Stories 1-6]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the timing figures in scenarios consistent with the adapter each scenario uses, so no scenario passes for a regression? [Consistency, Spec §FR-036, §FR-038]
- [ ] CHK018 Is each of the six user stories given an independent test that can be run without the others? [Completeness, Spec §User Stories]

## Consistency across artifacts

- [ ] CHK019 Does every fixture question in the contract's §5 table appear with the same type and rules wherever the spec names it? [Consistency, Contract §5]
- [ ] CHK020 Does every FR the contracts cite exist, and does every contract rule the spec cites exist? [Traceability]
- [ ] CHK021 Are the eight viewer states, the catalog states and the not-found screen partitioned without overlap or omission? [Consistency, Spec §FR-045, §FR-074]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the spec declared authoritative wherever a contract restates it, so a drift has a stated resolution? [Consistency, Contract §6]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK023 Is every assumption recorded as a decision with a reason, rather than as an open question? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK024 Are the assumptions about a service that does not yet exist marked as such, with the consequence of each being wrong stated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK025 Is any requirement that depends on the deployment topology (SPA index fallback) stated rather than inherited silently from the constitution? [Dependency, Spec §FR-076]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items annotated **failed** record what the author's own pass found and where it was fixed; the box is still the reviewer's to tick
